findings.claim: Slow consumer handler time (p95 ~2405 ms) drives slow deliveries; the consumer's auth time is normal (~70 ms).
findings.reason: Delivery total p95 ~2481 ms is almost entirely consumer handler time; early attempts took ~72 ms, later ones ~2480 ms.

findings.claim: Each delivery now takes ~2.5 s, so a serial poller could only manage ~0.4 deliveries/s, which would explain the drop to ~4 per 10 s.
findings.reason: This matches the observed rate. The deliveries stay under the 3000 ms timeout, so there are no failures, but serial polling is not directly shown.

limitations: The consumer is a test fixture, so why its handler became slow is not shown and its logs were not available.
